meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成符合 AWWWARDS 水准的网页设计代码，包括宽屏 Hero、无空隙 Bento 网格、GSAP 滚动动画、内联微图等，并强制使用 Python 模拟随机化来避免重复布局。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成网页 UI 代码（如 React/HTML 页面）时触发，尤其是需要高端、动效丰富的设计时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个创意作品集的首页，要有 GSAP 滚动动画。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含随机化布局和 GSAP 效果的代码。

say.text: 做一个 Bento 网格布局的关于我们页面，不要有空隙。
生成一个 Hero 区域，标题不超过 3 行，带全屏背景图。
say.note: Claude 会使用宽容器和 clamp 字号控制行数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates AWWWARDS-level web design code, including wide hero sections, gapless bento grids, GSAP scroll animations, inline micro-images, and enforces Python-driven randomization to avoid repetitive layouts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate web UI code (e.g., React/HTML pages), especially for high-end, motion-rich designs.

say_en.text: Design a creative portfolio homepage with GSAP scroll animations.
say_en.note: Claude outputs code with randomized layouts and GSAP effects.

say_en.text: Create an About Us page with a bento grid, no empty spaces.
say_en.note: Claude uses grid-flow-dense to ensure no gaps.

say_en.text: Generate a hero section with a title max 3 lines and full-bleed background.
say_en.note: Claude uses wide containers and clamp font size to limit lines.
